clusters.name: Electromagnetic induction (moving magnet/coil)
clusters.description: Converting relative motion between magnets and coils into AC electrical power via changing magnetic flux.

clusters.name: Oscillating-mass inertial harvester
clusters.description: Proof mass on springs or pendulums that moves relative to a frame to drive transducers from body motion.

clusters.name: Impact/oscillatory harvester
clusters.description: Converting periodic impacts or swings into pulses of electrical energy via inertial or piezo elements.

clusters.name: Piezoelectric transducer array
clusters.description: Elements that generate charge under bending or compression to harvest localized mechanical stress.

clusters.name: Triboelectric/surface-friction transducer
clusters.description: Harvesting charge from contact, sliding, or separation between dissimilar materials in wearables.

clusters.name: Variable-capacitance electromechanical transducer
clusters.description: Changing capacitor geometry via deformation to convert mechanical work into electrical energy.

clusters.name: Flexoelectric/strain-gradient transducer
clusters.description: Generating voltage from localized bending strain gradients for small-scale deformation harvesting.

clusters.name: Elastic spring energy storage
clusters.description: Storing mechanical energy in elastic elements to smooth or time-shift energy delivery.

clusters.name: Ratcheting/mechanical accumulation
clusters.description: One-way mechanisms that accumulate incremental motion into stored rotation or displacement for generation.

clusters.name: Mechanical transmission & gearing
clusters.description: Linkages, gears, belts, and shafts converting and scaling human motion into generator-friendly inputs.

clusters.name: Motion-phase gated coupling
clusters.description: Clutches or one-way couplings that engage harvesting only during beneficial motion phases.

clusters.name: Vibration amplification & resonance tuning
clusters.description: Resonators or amplifiers that increase low-amplitude motion into higher-amplitude transducer inputs.

clusters.name: Body-mounted motion converter
clusters.description: Interfaces (cranks, linkages, cams) that translate limb displacement into generator drive motion.

clusters.name: Limb-mounted compression actuator
clusters.description: Compressive pads or actuators that use joint motion to apply force to harvesters.

clusters.name: Belt/tread or internal circumferential mechanism
clusters.description: Moving-surface mechanisms (tread, belt) translating foot motion into continuous generator drive.

clusters.name: Pedal/crank drive conversion
clusters.description: Converting cyclical leg or arm strokes via cranks into rotational generator input.

clusters.name: Airflow and drag-driven capture
clusters.description: Flexible flaps or turbines using airflow from motion to produce rotational or oscillatory drive.

clusters.name: Deformation-driven fluid pump
clusters.description: Wearable pumps that pressurize fluid via body deformation to drive micro-turbines or pistons.

clusters.name: Hydraulic/pneumatic pressure reservoir
clusters.description: Pressurized fluid storage that stores and releases work to drive generators on demand.

clusters.name: Intermediate energy buffer (supercap/flywheel)
clusters.description: Short-term electrical or mechanical storage smoothing intermittent harvested energy before conditioning.

clusters.name: Portable energy storage (battery/supercap)
clusters.description: Compact electrochemical or capacitive storage holding harvested energy for later use.

clusters.name: Power conditioning & impedance matching
clusters.description: Electronics that rectify, regulate, combine, and match harvested signals into usable power outputs.

clusters.name: Direct local power routing
clusters.description: Immediate routing of harvested energy to on-body accessories or sensors without long transmission paths.

clusters.name: Detachable modular capture & storage
clusters.description: Removable harvesters with local storage for on-demand attachment, charging, or offload.

clusters.name: Distributed limb harvesters
clusters.description: Multiple small units on extremities that collectively harvest energy from natural gait cycles.

clusters.name: Flexible wearable substrate integration
clusters.description: Embedding harvesters and conductors into textiles or elastomers for conformal, comfortable harvesting.

clusters.name: Elastic deformable element array
clusters.description: Arrays of compressible elements distributing and converting distributed kinetic inputs into usable work.

clusters.name: Motion sensing and control logic
clusters.description: Sensors and algorithms that detect motion phases and optimize harvesting timing or routing.

clusters.name: Activity-dependent gating & software policies
clusters.description: Software rules that enable, limit, or prioritize device functions based on activity or harvested energy.

clusters.name: User feedback & status display
clusters.description: Local interfaces (LED, haptic) that present charge, harvesting status, and usage prompts to the wearer.

clusters.name: Offload/interface for external conditioning
clusters.description: Ports and protocols to transfer harvested energy to external devices or centralized conditioners.

clusters.name: Galvanic or skin-potential harvesting
clusters.description: Harvesting small voltages between skin and electrodes for supplemental power.

clusters.name: Skin-to-air thermoelectric harvesting
clusters.description: Low-power thermoelectric modules exploiting skin-to-ambient gradients for continuous trickle energy.
